markscheme.html:
Correct answer: B

A: Force and acceleration are both vector quantities. [0]

B: Pressure is a scalar quantity (it has magnitude but no unique direction); gravitational field strength is a vector quantity (directed towards the center of the mass). [1]

C: Displacement and velocity are both vector quantities. [0]

D: Mass and distance are both scalar quantities. [0]
